configuration.normalization: Training-cube fold only; whole episode sequence, no downsampling.
configuration.target_labels: Read from cubes.json for supervised diagnostic probes only.

probes.f8_interpretation: Empirical one-episode recoverability benchmark, not a mathematical signal ceiling or upper bound; five-lift z uses more evidence.
probes.f2_rule: Both properties must have held-out-cube R² < 0.1 in each of five seeds; threshold not relaxed for pilot.
